decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( HSW017_HARTINGTON ROAD DNS 50813 001, HSW017_HARTINGTON ROAD DNS 50813 002, HSW017_HARTINGTON ROAD DNS 50813 003, HSW017_HARTINGTON ROAD DNS 50813 004 received on the 14.07.2015  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The Cabinet hereby approved is to be painted dark green
Condition : 4 - The Equipment cabin and telecom pole and apparatus must be removed from eh site when it is no longer required and the site returned to its current status as paved and grassed areas.
description: Replacement of existing 11.7m high phase 3 monopole for 11.7m phase 4 monopole with wrap around diplexor cabinet at base and the installation of a pogona cabinet measuring 1230 x 400 x 1032mm located at ground level
